title: Servers, Machines: a 20 character name and the host show in full
covers: Servers page, Machines tab list width
context: The Machines tab lists SSH machines. The list is wide enough for a name of 20 characters and the host without cutting them. The old extra text SSH key after the host was removed. Servers is in the sidebar under Hosting.
changed: screens hosting/servers: Machines tab list width and row text

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: machine
setup.text: No real machine is needed. The test saves a made up one and you delete it at the end.

steps: In the sidebar, under Hosting, open Servers. The page has two tabs: Machines and Archipelia servers. Open Machines.
Press Add server. In the box Server label type ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRST (20 characters) and press Add.

In the editor set Host to archipelago-hos net, User name to tester, Authentication to SSH key file, Key file to C:\fake\id_ed25519, and Archipelago path on the host to /home/tes Press Save in the bar at the bottom.

In the list the row shows ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRST in full, with no cut and no three dots. Under the name the host reads archipelago-host-01.example.net in full, without a note about SSH key or password. At the right a status reads not tested.
Drag the divider between the list and the editor to its narrowest and widest. The name and host stay whole at the default width.
Delete the made up server with the trash button in its row and confirm.
pass: The 20 character name shows in full in the list.
The host shows in full on the line under it, with no extra SSH key text.
The list can be resized and starts wide enough at its default width.
fail: The name or the host ends in three dots at the default width.
The line under the name still adds SSH key or password.
notes: The Archipelia servers tab is the next test.
No change to this page since bundle-1, so a pass there carries over unless the layout broke.
